chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man upon whom there is some wealth for me, and he is insolvent. So I buy a sale (item) from a man to a specified term, upon a stipulation that I guarantee that from him for the man, and he fulfils me that which is upon him? He said: There is no problem.

key_terms.مُعْسِرٌ: Insolvent person (one who cannot pay their debt)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to guarantee a debt for an insolent person through a sale transaction in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi validates the practice of 'bay' al-daman' (buy-back with guarantee), where a creditor purchases goods on credit to secure repayment from a debtor who is currently insolvent (mu'sir). It highlights the flexibility of Shia jurisprudence in allowing commercial mechanisms to facilitate debt recovery while ensuring the transaction remains free from major legal defects, reflecting the practical needs of early Muslim communities.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man upon whom there is some wealth for me, and he is insolvent. So I buy an item for sale from a man to a specified term upon a stipulation that I guarantee that from him for the man, and he fulfils me that which is upon him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following:

“This is concerning my question before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who owes a certain amount of debts and he is a Mu‘sir (unable to pay). Can I arrange for him to buy something from a man for an appointed time and guarantee in his favor so he can pay his debts (with the item just purchased for him) to me and then pay back what he owes? He (the Imam) said, ‘It is lawful.’”
